blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr., on National Teachers’ Day on Monday, said the government is working to expedite the release of teachers’ 2024 Performance-Based Bonus (PBB). He made the assurance in his speech during the National Teachers’ Day celebration in Quezon City, where he also highlighted the government’s efforts to recognize and support the country’s educators.
